CounterManual.title: When you hand it over
CounterManual.b2_n: heart ones are a pain to wash
CounterManual.fire_b: not if they have fangs. that's beast
CounterManual.fire_c: green eyes means forest, starlight first if it fits
CounterManual.star_a: blue eyes + long pointy ears out to the side
CounterManual.star_b: needs both! one alone isn't it
CounterManual.star_c: animal ears don't count, even pointy
CounterManual.star_d: writes better at night (or I think so)
CounterManual.dry: let it dry before handing over, it smudges
CounterManual.last: got it wrong last time and the customer couldn't read the label
CounterManual.smile: hand it over with a smile
Cover.title: Mind the shop for a bit!
Cover.step1: Your friend passes on what the customer says
Cover.step1_a: skip the chit-chat! just have them read the three bold lines
Cover.step2: Find the one memo with those symptoms
Cover.step2_a: one page per medicine. just skim the very top
Cover.step3: Describe the three ingredients drawn on it
Cover.step3_a: each shelf has three look-alikes. grab any old one and it's a dud!
Cover.step3_b: give two of colour, pattern, shape so only one is left
Cover.shelf_b: three of a kind per shelf
Cover.step4: All in? Then look at the last page, 'When you hand it over'!
Cover.closing: Read all this? Tell your friend downstairs to let the customer in!
Cover.cat: don't feed the cat. already ate
POT_01.customers: Customers whose shadow runs late (keep coming)
POT_01.s1: Their shadow trails way behind. Turn a corner and it's still back at the last one
POT_01.s3: Look back and the floor's empty, gives them chills
POT_01.s4: Sit down and the shadow sits a beat later
POT_01.s5: Step through a door and the shadow's stuck outside!
POT_01.s6: Started after rushing somewhere, they say
POT_01.name: Shadow Hurry-Up
POT_01.i1_b: big white spots on the cap
POT_01.i1_c: a scab on the very top
POT_01.i1_d: underside of the cap flat, like it was cut
POT_01.i3_c: a few thick pillars in the middle
POT_01.cook: Boil all three in the pot
POT_02.s1: The end of what they say comes back twice, back twice
POT_02.s3: Even talking to themselves comes back
POT_02.s4: Sing and they turn into a one-person round
POT_02.s5: Even whispers come back, so no secrets
POT_02.s6: Started after shouting into a well or a cave, they say
POT_02.s8: Cotton in the ears didn't help
POT_02.name: Last-Word Knot
POT_02.i1_a: the one with a black tip
POT_02.i2_d: the stone under it is darkish
POT_02.cook_note: you'll whisper for a while after (that's normal)
POT_03.s1: Getting lighter and lighter. The scale needle barely moves
POT_03.s3: Worse on windy days. Hold on to door handles
POT_03.s4: Walk around with stones in their pockets
POT_03.s5: Float down the stairs two at a time
POT_03.s6: Started after a strong spring wind, they say
POT_03.name: Feet-Down Tonic
POT_03.i2_g: break it and I clean up
POT_03.i3_c: shaped like a barrel on its side
POT_03.i3_f: sand left inside. shake it out
POT_03.cook: Boil all three in the pot
POT_03.cook_note: tell them not to let go of the door handle till it's all gone!!
POT_04.s2: They themselves are wide awake all night
POT_04.s3: The reflection yawns on its own. They didn't
POT_04.s4: The reflection opens its eyes way late
POT_04.s5: Even the face in the wash basin is dozing
POT_04.s6: Lots of them keep an old mirror in the bedroom
POT_04.s7: Covering it with a cloth helped for a few days
POT_04.name: Mirror Wake-Up
POT_04.i1_b: growth rings on the cut face
POT_04.i1_d: splits in two at the bottom
POT_04.i2_b: the one with a black tip
POT_04.cook_note: tell them to go to bed early that night
POT_05.customers: Customers who taste rain in everything
POT_05.s1: Everything tastes like water caught under the eaves. Even honey
POT_05.s2: Tongue tingles the day before rain
POT_05.s3: Their breath smells like a yard after rain
POT_05.s6: Started after a long rainy season, they say
POT_05.s8: Thanks to it, they predict the weather perfectly
POT_05.name: Taste-Back Tonic
POT_05.i1_a: white spots all over the cap
POT_05.i1_c: cap tip bends to one side
POT_05.i2_b: growth rings on the cut face
POT_05.i3_c: fat at the top, narrow at the bottom
POT_05.i3_e: keeps falling over when stood up
POT_05.cook: Boil all three in the pot
POT_05.cook_note: warn them the first sip is super sweet
POT_06.s2: Everything they hold frosts over. Even cups
POT_06.s3: Worst in the morning. Blanket edges frozen
POT_06.s4: Frost forms even inside their gloves
POT_06.s5: Even a hot iron cools in their grip
POT_06.s6: Three pairs of gloves don't help
POT_06.name: Fingertip Thaw
POT_06.i1_b: the one with a blue stem
POT_06.i1_d: stem gets paler towards the bottom
POT_06.cook_note: gloves off, cup it in both hands to drink
